About our developer tools

Because everything runs in your browser, it's safe to paste API responses, tokens and config files. Nothing is logged or uploaded. The JSON formatter pinpoints syntax errors to the exact line and column, and the hash generator uses the Web Crypto API for SHA digests and HMAC.

Need identifiers? The UUID generator produces random v4 and time-ordered v7 UUIDs in bulk, and the mock data generator exports seed data as JSON or CSV.

Frequently asked questions

Is it safe to paste secrets or tokens?

Yes. These tools don't send your input anywhere; processing happens in JavaScript on your device. You can even disconnect from the internet and they keep working.

What's the difference between UUID v4 and v7?

UUID v4 is fully random. UUID v7 starts with a millisecond timestamp, so values sort by creation time, which makes them friendlier as database primary keys.

Does the Base64 encoder support emoji and non-Latin text?

Yes. Text is encoded as UTF-8 before Base64 encoding, so emoji, Arabic, Chinese and other scripts round-trip correctly.
